column3: “All the days which they are alive on the surface of the land” is rendered “as long as they live in the land.”
“Your name has been called on this house” is rendered “this house … is called by Your name.”
“Do their justice” is rendered “maintain their cause.”
NASB uses parentheses; “deliver up them before” is rendered “deliver them to.”
“Bring back to their heart” is rendered “take thought,” and “seek favor” as “make supplication.” “Done wrong” is rendered “committed iniquity.”
“Do their justice” is rendered “maintain their cause.”
NASB adds “I pray You” for “please” and supplies “offered.”
“Faithful ones” is rendered “godly ones,” and “in the good” as “in what is good.”
“Faces” is rendered “face.” “The covenant loyalties of David” is rendered “Your lovingkindness to … David”; the Hebrew may also mean David's acts of loyalty, and the meaning is uncertain.
